name: Funder–NGO Fit Rubric v2 (7 criteria, 14 sub-criteria, 100 points)
notes: Same 7 criteria and 100 points as v1, each split into 2–3 weighted sub-criteria anchored to cited numeric precedents (World Bank QCBS, RFP-industry weighting bands, published government grant rubrics, ~60/40 Pareto split). NOTE: v2 criterion numbering differs from v1 (2=Geography, 3=Target Population, 4=Eligibility). Source: hand-vetting/Funder_NGO_Fit_Rubric_KABIL_v2.md. v2 scores were NOT hand-vetted as of 2026-09-21.

criteria.label: Thematic/Sector Alignment
criteria.guiding_question: Does the funder's stated priority match the NGO's core and secondary work?

criteria.label: Primary theme match
criteria.guiding_question: Does the funder's #1 stated/largest priority area match the NGO's core work?

criteria.label: Secondary/cross-cutting theme match
criteria.guiding_question: Do the funder's other (non-flagship) verticals also overlap with the NGO's secondary programs?

criteria.label: Geography
criteria.guiding_question: Is the funder active in the NGO's region, down to the district?

criteria.label: Regional presence
criteria.guiding_question: Is the funder active in the NGO's state / broader region generally?

criteria.label: District/hyper-local specificity
criteria.guiding_question: Is there a confirmed, named project at the exact district/block level?

criteria.label: Target Population
criteria.guiding_question: Does the funder's beneficiary group and expected scale match the NGO's?

criteria.label: Primary beneficiary match
criteria.guiding_question: Does the funder's main beneficiary group match the NGO's actual beneficiaries?

criteria.label: Scale/demographic alignment
criteria.guiding_question: Does the expected scale (households/individuals) match what the NGO typically delivers?

criteria.label: Eligibility & Compliance
criteria.guiding_question: Does the NGO clear the legal, funder-specific, and transparency bars?

criteria.label: Legal form & core registrations
criteria.guiding_question: Correct legal form (Society/Section 8/Trust) + valid 12A + 80G?

criteria.label: Funder-specific hard gates
criteria.guiding_question: FCRA (if relevant) + CSR-1 (if funder is Section-135-bound) + minimum track-record years?

criteria.label: Financial transparency & governance
criteria.guiding_question: Publicly available audited financials/annual reports + visible governance structure (per the 2025 CSR rule)?

criteria.label: Relationship/Warmth (Linkage)
criteria.guiding_question: Direct relationship and/or warm-introduction potential?

criteria.label: Existing direct relationship
criteria.guiding_question: Is there a confirmed, currently-active relationship?

criteria.label: Warm-introduction/third-party potential
criteria.guiding_question: Are there shared partners, co-branded field visits, or other indirect affinity signals?

criteria.label: Funding Size & Type Fit
criteria.guiding_question: Do grant size and funding structure both fit?

criteria.label: Grant size appropriateness
criteria.guiding_question: Does the funder's typical grant size match the NGO's realistic ask?

criteria.label: Funding structure fit
criteria.guiding_question: Project vs core, multi-year vs one-off, and monetary vs in-kind (in-kind doesn't count for CSR-bound funders)?

criteria.label: Funder Capacity & Trend
criteria.guiding_question: Financial trend and strategic/governance stability?

criteria.label: Financial trend
criteria.guiding_question: Is the funder's overall giving growing, stable, or declining (year-over-year)?

criteria.label: Strategic/governance stability
criteria.guiding_question: Is the funder's leadership/strategy stable, or in flux?
